evidence.observation: o2_exhaust not_installed; growth stage requires exhaust O2 to verify the atmosphere
Tracked the ramp closely; brief overshoot to 759.8 °C at start of growth, then held within ±1 °C of 750 °C with steady heater power of about 44%
Ar steady at ~100 sccm, matching the setpoint
Pressure steady at ~760 Torr throughout, but at atmospheric pressure this would not reveal a small air leak

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading, or another independent check of the atmosphere such as a leak check or a portable O2 analyzer, to confirm the tube is oxygen-free during growth; later, characterization of the sample.
